title: DevGate runner-monitor registry (instance state, never committed)

_comment.description: Explanatory prose for a human reading the redacted example. Declared here because the example carries it and this schema closes itself to undeclared keys — an example that violates its own schema teaches the wrong shape.

token_salt.description: Per-registry salt for heartbeat-token hashing (mon-sec-02). Generated on first use and persisted; heartbeat verifiers are stored only as salted hashes.

enrollment_tokens.description: One-time enrollment tokens; consumed on successful /enroll.

heartbeat_token_hash.description: Salted sha256 of the heartbeat token — the plaintext token is never stored (mon-sec-02). Null after revocation.

image_digest.description: The digest-qualified evaluator ref this host would gate with, or null when it cannot serve the pinned image (img-cycle-03). Null is UNKNOWN, never healthy.

image_reason.description: Why image_digest is null, in the host's own words. The vocabulary the shipped probe uses, one fault per fix: 'not provisioned: <vars> not set' | 'podman not on PATH' | 'store does not exist: <path>' | 'podman info failed for the configured store' | 'store mismatch: podman reports <a>, configured <b>' | 'pinned image absent from the store (not pulled)'. Free text from an untrusted-as-input host, so consumers must render it, never match on it.

image_pin_divergence.description: The host's report that the registry's served digest for the published tag no longer equals the recorded image_manifest_digest (img-cycle-05). Non-empty string names both digests ('served <image>:<tag> is <served> but the record is <record> — a re-pin is due'). Null means the host checked and they agree, OR it could not check — the two are deliberately the same value here because both mean 'no divergence was observed', and the check itself is a repository-reachable fact the publish job and the hub also carry. A key left out entirely means an older helper that does not report this field. Free text from an untrusted-as-input host, so consumers must render it, never match on it. Divergence is a fact about the repository, not a fault on the host (design D6): the tick still succeeds.

scan_state.description: The last fleet secret sweep this host reported (secret-scan-07), or null when it has no scan state to report. Null is UNKNOWN, never healthy: a host that has never been swept is not a swept-and-clean host. 'unreadable' is set when a report exists on the host and would not parse, and it is NOT an empty fleet.

repos.description: One record per declared repository. A repository the sweep could not fetch appears here with its state and reason rather than being omitted.

state.description: The sweep's own vocabulary: clean | findings | unfetchable | unscannable.

unreadable.description: Why this host's report could not be read, or null when it was read. Free text from an untrusted-as-input host, so consumers must render it, never match on it.
